items:
Forever Grateful by Royal Destinations

Location: Dune Allen Beach
Address: 4525 West County Highway 30A

Details:
Forever Grateful has just emerged from a complete luxury renovation, transforming it into one of the most exceptional Gulf front estates on 30A. Step into a designer-curated retreat featuring a gourmet kitchen with premium appliances, marble flooring, and stunning all-new interiors. Outside, the expanded deck invites you to unwind in the sun or savor a moonlit dinner with nothing but the sound of rolling waves. This home is truly one of a kind. Whether you're hosting a beach wedding, planning a company retreat, gathering the family, or treating yourself to an unforgettable getaway, Forever Grateful offers an unmatched setting. Enjoy unobstructed Gulf views from every level, including the private guest house—an experience that is impossible to replicate.

If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental.

Home Highlights:
-Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front with Private Access (150 Feet of Private Beach)
-Parking Spaces: (3) in Garage and (4) in Driveway
-Dining Accommodations: Table for 8, Bar Seating for 3, Outdoor Seating for 12
-Coffee Maker Available
-*Small Events Welcome (With Approval)
*Maximum Capacity: 50 people
*Event Fee: $3,000
-*Private Heated Pool: 12’ x 10’
*Pool Heat is available for an additional $280 (pre-tax).
*The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees.
*Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay.

Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements:
Sleeps: 26
8 Bedrooms / 7.5 Baths

Main House:
6 Beds / 5.5 Baths

First Floor:
-Bedroom 1 (Handicap Accessible): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower)
-Bedroom 2: (2) Queen Beds with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)
-Gourmet Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area / Laundry Room
-Half Bath

Second Floor:
-Bedroom 3 (Master): King Bed and Sleeper Sofa with Private Bath (Soaking Tub/Shower) and Gulf Views
-Bedroom 4 (Bunk Room): Twin/Twin Bunk and Full/Full Bunk with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo). Equipped with a dutch door
-Bedroom 5: King Bed with Detached Shared Full Bath (Shower) and Balcony Access (Gulf View)
-Bedroom 6: Queen Bed with Detached Shared Full Bath (Shower)
-Hall Wet Bar

Guest House:
2 Beds / 2 Baths
-Bedroom 7: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower)
-Bedroom 8: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)

Amenities Include:
-6 Adult Bikes
-3 Beach Service Sets*
*Seasonal: March – October

Please Note:
*Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival.
*The master bedroom fireplace and home surround sound are not functional.

Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
